# Jawla Advance Technology LLP

> Jawla Advance Technology LLP is a packaging machine manufacturer based in Ballabgarh, Faridabad (Haryana), serving Delhi NCR, India and export markets. It builds 15 models in-house, including vertical FFS pouch machines, liquid packaging machines, auger and cup fillers, multi-head weighing machines, horizontal rotary machines, horizontal flow wrap pillow pack machines and biscuit, rusk and cream biscuit packaging machines. The company reports 19+ years of experience, 500+ clients and supplies to 25+ countries.

Website: https://www.jawlaadvancetechnology.com
Contact: sales@jawlatechnology.in | +91 99900 33381
Factory: Sarurpur Industrial Area, Sohna Road, Ballabgarh, Faridabad, Haryana

## Products

- [Products overview](https://www.jawlaadvancetechnology.com/products): all packaging machine models
- [Normal FFS Packaging Machine (JAT-301)](https://www.jawlaadvancetechnology.com/normal-ffs-packaging-machine-jat-301): 2 g to 200 g pouches, 30 to 80 pouches per minute
- [FFS High Speed Packaging Machine (JAT-302)](https://www.jawlaadvancetechnology.com/ffs-high-speed-packaging-machine): 2 g to 100 g sachets, 100 to 450 pouches per minute

- [One-Edge Biscuit Packaging Machine (JAT-311)](https://www.jawlaadvancetechnology.com/one-edge-biscuit-packaging-machine)
